records.title: Effect of artificial light on the drift of aquatic insects in urban central Texas streams
records.design: Random-order lit and ambient nights within a week, autumn 2012; 4 x 300 W incandescent, mean 1482 lx vs <2 lx; 2h net.
records.unit: Five stream blocks, two site-nights each, one net per occasion.
records.site_coordinates: Five site coordinates in Methods; see site_pairs.
records.endpoint: Total larvae caught per two-hour drift net; abundance in drift is not standing stock.
records.finding: Four streams lower, Barton higher; all-taxon paired drift-density test nonsignificant.
records.data_status: Table 1 visually checked; complete paired counts.
records.identity_warning: Table totals differ from narrative aggregates; see site_pairs.

records.title: Artificial light as a disturbance to light-naïve streams
records.design: Four forested streams with lit and control reaches; summer four weeks in primary dissertation.
records.unit: Four paired streams. Spring is tributary of East, separated at study reaches by 500 m.
records.site_coordinates: Malcolm Knapp Research Forest, 49°16′N, 122°34′W (area-level); Blaney, East, G, Spring.
records.endpoint: Invertebrate drift, insect emergence, insect infall are distinct responses.
records.finding: Lower nighttime drift; no significant response in emergence or infall.
records.data_status: Published original-reach workbook identified, direct link returned 403.
records.identity_warning: Separate from Perkin's 2010 German oxbow and gammarid flumes.

records.title: LED lighting threatens adult aquatic insects: Impact magnitude and distance thresholds
records.design: Study A: four spatial pairs stratified across two blocks and 3/40 m river distance, 90 m between lit/control; 6 dates; 20 W, 1500 lm white LED. Study B: lit only.
records.unit: Four concurrent lit/unlit pairs on a sampling night, two pairs per distance, reused across six dates; audit site allocation schedule before assigning n.
records.site_coordinates: Gürbe, Switzerland, 46°49′N, 7°30′E, area-level; 3 and 40 m in A; 3–80 m in B.
records.endpoint: Modified flight-intercept counts, sticky and hand collection; three insect orders.
records.finding: Higher lit catch in all three orders. Study B only informs distance within lit traps.
records.data_status: Repository README verified; numeric workbook not recovered.
records.identity_warning: Two studies and theses are not independent lit/dark programmes; B lacks dark comparator.

records.title: Artificial illumination near rivers may alter bat-insect trophic interactions
records.design: Eight sites >2 km apart, dark first and lit second; 250–310 lx, 4000–4500 K; 3 h after sunset.
records.unit: Eight paired river sites, four nested sticky traps each; treatment fixed in temporal order; bats sampled on different nights.
records.site_coordinates: Park-level 41°47′20″N, 13°46′33″E. Seven Sangro and one Zittola sites; trap onshore, three over water about 1–7 m from pole.
records.endpoint: Passive insect sticky-trap captures, bat pass proxy separately.
records.finding: Lit captures up locally, particularly small Diptera near lamp; taxa vary.
records.data_status: Online appendix cited in accepted manuscript; no raw site table verified.
records.identity_warning: Also newly found in supplementary Europe PMC search. BAT activity is not individual attacks on insects.

records.title: The effects of artificial lighting on adult aquatic and terrestrial insects
records.design: Six HPS lamps switched together on eleven nights and off eleven nights; dark always first in successive paired nights.
records.unit: Single field site and treatment array; 11 paired periods, 12 spatial trap locations, three heights nested; no independent light sites.
records.site_coordinates: Island/oxbow of the Spree river Germany, 52°22′N 13°48′E (area). Traps 5, 8, 80 m from water.
records.endpoint: Flying aquatic and terrestrial insect passive intercept counts by distance and height.
records.finding: Near-lamp capture increased substantially when lit; aquatic share larger at 0, 3 and 40 m from lamps.
records.data_status: Publisher supplement meteorology, comparisons, figures. Raw per-unit file not verified.
records.identity_warning: Different coordinates from Westhavelland ditch and from British Columbia Perkin experiment.

records.title: Phototaxis and polarotaxis hand in hand: night dispersal flight of aquatic insects distracted synergistically by light intensity and reflection polarization
records.design: Four-choice field experiment, unlit/lit × shiny/matte, simultaneous 125 W mercury lamps, five sampling dates in July.
records.unit: Single 50 × 50 m array, hour-blocked randomized relocation; individual landings and hours not independent illuminated landscapes.
records.endpoint: Aquatic insect landings/manual captures per surface per hour, choice/attraction.
records.finding: Lamp and horizontal polarization both increased counts; interaction.
records.data_status: Accepted full text, tables, hourly design; raw per-hour archive unverified.
records.identity_warning: Use matched substrate and same choice-set contrasts; denominator is attraction, not population.

records.title: Multiple stressors across ecosystem boundaries: Do light pollution and invasive species change the quality of aquatic prey for terrestrial predators?
records.design: May 24–July 6, 2022, ALAN × invasive crayfish, randomized 16 stream-bank mesocosms, 20±2 lx neutral white LED vs ambient, 21:00–06:00.
records.unit: Four whole flumes per cell; 3 nested emergence traps and repeated sampling.
records.endpoint: Emergent insect biomass per unit area and day weeks 1,4,6; crayfish activity separately. Fatty acid measurements are other endpoints.
records.finding: Crayfish decreased emergence biomass; ALAN effects analyzed by week; avoid mistaking fall in prey biomass from crayfish for ALAN effect.
records.data_status: Author code/data repository located; files not numerically audited.
records.identity_warning: Same experiment and dates as Ogbeide2026 within one day at termination; evidence for same programme. Week-6 biomass cannot fill missing Week-6 counts.

records.title: Out of the Dark: Establishing a Large-Scale Field Experiment to Assess the Effects of Artificial Light at Night on Species and Food Webs
records.design: Pilot across ten nights; dark baseline followed by lighting one 12-lamp site; companion site dark.
records.unit: One impact and one control landscape, repeated traps/nights are subsamples.
records.site_coordinates: Westhavelland, Germany; companion study map 52°41′29.81″N,12°27′37.54″E, not trap-specific.
records.endpoint: Flying insect and spider trap catch per effort.
records.finding: Increase in insect catches after lighting.
records.data_status: Publisher primary and supporting materials accessed; raw files unverified.
records.identity_warning: Same Westhavelland sites as Manfrin2017 and 2025; likely 2012 catch overlap.

records.title: Temporal Variation in the Impact of Artificial Light at Night on Aquatic-Terrestrial Insect Fluxes
records.design: 30 stations with four LED colours and dark at two habitats; seven dates.
records.unit: Fixed station, repeated dates; 3 stations per treatment × habitat.
records.site_coordinates: Waterfowl Pond, Seven Ponds, Michigan; exact station coordinates not verified.
records.endpoint: Pan trap capture and biomass across riparian/littoral habitat.
records.finding: Violet catch greatest with date dependence.
records.data_status: Primary supplement displays graphs; data on request.
records.identity_warning: Existing inventory. Strongly suspected June 3 overlap with Parkinson2023; not an independent study family.

records.title: Urban light pollution alters the diel vertical migration of Daphnia
records.design: Experimental lake surface shielding, black vs clear enclosures and open lake referent; new moon period July 7–8.
records.unit: Three black and three clear enclosures; three open-water locations. Depth/bottle samples nested.
records.site_coordinates: Lake Waban, Massachusetts; exact station coordinates unverified.
records.endpoint: Depth-specific zooplankton vertical migration/proportion, not whole-lake abundance.
records.finding: Daphnia vertical distribution changed with shielding, other cladocerans and copepods lacked clear responses.
records.data_status: Primary paper figures/tables; individual raw unverified.
records.identity_warning: Historical pre-2010 context; shading attenuates natural light too.

records.title: The Effect of Electric Bridge Lighting at Night on Mayfly Activity
records.design: Seven trials of roadway lighting CCT, shielding, under-bridge light; June–August.
records.unit: Three spans of one bridge on six nonconsecutive days; within-night observations nested.
records.site_coordinates: Veterans Memorial Bridge, Susquehanna River, Pennsylvania; exact span coordinates unverified.
records.endpoint: Mayfly counts near bridge roadway lights.
records.finding: Spectral/position dependent responses, CCT comparison nonsignificant.
records.identity_warning: All-lit roadway background for main comparisons; separate retrofit/mitigation, do not assume dark control.

henn_qc: Confirmed against visual PDF Table 1, p.312. Table totals 1229 lit + 1961 ambient = 3190; Results narrative lists 1212 + 1979 = 3191. Site totals are a different endpoint from volume-standardized drift density.

additional_primary_followup.status: also in new Europe PMC screen, not a twelfth independent citation harvest
additional_primary_followup.endpoint: underwater floating-trap phototactic captures; active method
additional_primary_followup.design: Four randomized blocks in two Westhavelland ditches (two blocks per ditch), four nights in May-June 2017, four colors and unlit stick in each block-night, 20 traps nightly. Blue/green intensities varied across nights; not a full intensity-by-color factorial. Traps 15 m apart.
additional_primary_followup.context: Near the Westhavelland long-term field site; distinct 2017 short-term lamp experiment. Do not treat as four independent landscapes.
additional_primary_followup.finding: All six lit treatments increased total insect capture relative to the dark controls. Taxon-specific responses differed.
additional_primary_followup.data_status: Publisher lists supplementary data and says original data available upon request following embargo.
